title: Open Image Template
description: A portable template format for reusable AI image generation prompts.

standard.description: The standard identifier. Open Image Template documents use the constant open-image-template.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the Open Image Template schema used by this document.

id.description: Stable URL-safe template identifier, used in /templates/{id} and /templates/{id}.json.

description.description: Short explanation of what the template helps generate.

category.description: Primary gallery category for browsing and discovery.

tags.description: Search and discovery terms published by the canonical catalogue.

canonical_url.description: Canonical human-readable page for this template.

summary_prompt.description: Short human-facing prompt summary for compact browsing interfaces.

nsfw.description: Whether the template preview contains sensitive 18+ material and should be hidden behind a reveal control by default.

prompt.description: The full visible prompt. Open Image Templates should not depend on hidden prompt text.

demo_prompt.description: Fallback prompt used when a recommended or required input image is not present.

negative_prompt.description: Optional negative prompt phrases or constraints.

content_tier.description: Content classification used by consumer browsing policies.

input_requirements.description: Optional inputs a consumer should request before generation.

image.description: An optional or required reference image requested by the template.

slots.description: Main editable variables in the template. Render these as user-editable fields in prompt-builder interfaces.

example.description: Example value that shows how the slot should be filled.

controls.description: Human-facing prompt-builder controls for adjusting a reusable image template.

label.description: Human-facing label for opening or rendering this control group.

promptLabel.description: Label used when compiling the selected value back into a prompt.

value.description: Prompt value inserted when this option is selected.

image.description: Optional preview image for visual tile selection.

label.description: Human-facing label for the freeform detail field.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text that explains what extra details can contain.

instruction.description: Prompt instruction appended when the toggle is enabled.

suggested_models.description: Model suggestions for this template. These are recommendations, not requirements.

settings.description: Portable model settings suggested for this template.

examples.description: Preview examples generated for the template, including provenance.

image_alt.description: Accessible description of the example image.

generated_at.description: Date the example image was generated.

schema_version.description: Schema version used when the example was generated.

source_notes.description: Optional provenance or editorial notes supplied with the template.
